punchline: On United 173 the crew knew the fuel was low but deferred to the captain, and crew resource management was born.
thirty_sec: In 1978 a United DC-8 circled near Portland with a landing gear problem. The first officer and the flight engineer tried to flag the fuel but did not press it, and the plane ran out of fuel and crashed. Investigators blamed missed monitoring and unclear communication. Airlines then taught crews to speak up and captains to listen.
